text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: “—Gooooooo!! Run, Fine Motion!!”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hrrraaaaagh!! Fine-san...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
(No, I won't! I don't want to give it up, 
I won't give it up, my—)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—I will definitely... not lose...! 
Aaaaargh...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell is that look for...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That roar... that burning passion. Those 
are things you shouldn't be able to bare, 
right...?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
“...... No, can it change? *Can* I change 
it? Hey, could it be—?”

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If it's you, will you... smash everything 
to pieces for me...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...! Are you an idiot? She's about to be 
gone anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Right, assuming everything went 
according to data. But if there's even a 
millimeter of a hole in it—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO~H!!!! This is fiercely intense!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami, you were amazing~! To put a stop 
to Fine's momentum like that...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I did iiiiiiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh, my!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"You can make a face like that too, 
Fine-san. Your eyes are blazing with 
intensity!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You must have gotten exceptionally fired 
up!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I understand completely. It was such an 
exhilarating race. Please, you must take 
your revenge next time!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, thank you, Kawakami-chan.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...Did I just—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Did you forget that you are "Fine Motion"?

She couldn't defeat Kawakami Princess, who 
had declared war on her. Yet on her face, 
something beyond mere frustration could be 
seen—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...I think I understand now why racing is 
so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Because everyone is competing with the 
pure, simple desire to 'win.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami-chan was overjoyed when she beat 
me. That is how much she had riding on 
that race.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Once I started wanting to win, the fun 
doubled for me, too! Even though I lost 
today."

While that's likely how she truly felt, I 
sensed it wasn't what she actually wanted 
to talk about. Just as I was about to ask—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's decide on next year's 
races.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I have to keep running. ...I want to 
choose wonderful races again.

With her caliber, she can probably keep 
challenging the high-level GⅠ circuit just 
like this. However, the battles will 
naturally become tough.
choice_data_list:
Is it okay to keep challenging races like 
this?

Is it okay to keep challenging races like 
this?

text_block_list.text:
It was a question asking her to reaffirm 
her resolve as a racing Umamusume, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course! Now, please go on.
choice_data_list: What do you think about the "Osaka Hai"?

text_block_list.text:
The "Osaka Hai"—the GⅠ race that decides 
the top medium-distance runner of the 
spring. Given her abilities and the 
prestige of the race, I'd wanted to take 
on the challenge.
choice_data_list: Tough rivals are sure to show up again.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: ...! Yeah. I pray for that too.

And so, the next goal was set: the first 
leg of the Spring Senior Spring Triple 
Crown, the Osaka Hai.

Upon returning to the waiting room—an 
unexpected guest was waiting.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So you really did come to watch? I 
believed in you—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you can afford to take it 
this easy? You only have—one year left on 
your time limit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"D'ya even understand what that means?! 
All that fun ya just discovered will 
completely vanish!"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
――Meanin' not a single one's gonna be 
left. They're all just gonna turn into 
those "memories" you love so much.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, spare me the lecture, alright? I'm 
just stating the facts.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I told you before, didn't I? This is her 
peak. The data shows a gradual end.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If you don't want that... your only choice 
is to struggle. You get that, don't you, 
Fine?

I don't know Air Shakur very well, but 
she's not the type to hurt someone 
needlessly. She must have a clear 
intention behind this, but—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Look at Shakur, acting all 
villainous.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It happens all the time, so don't worry 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've set our sights on the Osaka 
Hai! Let's go grab some Kyoto ramen♪

Fine Motion acts as she always does. Her 
smile is perfectly bright—yet somehow 
filled with a subtle unease.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
“—I definitely... won't lose...! 
Aaaaarrrghhh...!”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...It would've been better if I never 
knew. Because everything—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Even though it'll all disappear anyway.
